Nothing is waiting.

Candidates arrive here when a manual has been read and not yet checked. Nothing is bundled — the bench reviews the manuals you fetched, and a queue that shipped pre-filled would be somebody else's homework already marked. 

node scripts/source-manuals.js --kind dishwashers --limit 10
node scripts/learn-manual.js manuals/*.pdf --brand Bosch --kind Dishwasher

Or read one now.

Drop a manufacturer's PDF — any appliance, any brand, nothing here is coded for yours. It is read in this browser's request and thrown away; nothing is uploaded anywhere and nothing is added to the library.

Or paste a fault table — from a manufacturer's web page, a spreadsheet, or a PDF you copied
